decisions.reason: The LED track spotlight line has been on the market since 2023, is part of the firm's announced modular system direction and has its own page, so prior investment and visible commitment argue for keeping it.
The LED ceiling luminaire line is core to the portfolio, publicly presented with several models and backed by dealer support, so management persists and treats any weak results as temporary.
Launched only in 2024 as a multi-model line with its own page, the flexible spotlight is too new to judge, and any shortfall can be attributed to the launch phase.
The multi-outlet canopy is a system component supporting the firm's modular lighting concept and was recently launched with its own page, so the commitment favours retention.
The low-voltage canopy complements the firm's system offer and was presented visibly in 2024, so management keeps it and attributes weak early results to market introduction.

The round glass track luminaires are only mentioned rather than featured, which signals less visible commitment, but as a recent multi-model line close to the core track system they are still likely to be kept.
